properties.name: opencelium.deployment-mode
properties.description: How this installation is operated: self (self-hosted, one customer, MongoDB from spring.mongodb.uri) or saas (operated for many tenants, spring.mongodb.uri names the system database and is required).

properties.name: opencelium.data-dir
properties.description: Directory for local state such as master.key. Created at startup when missing. Default: /var/lib/opencelium on Linux when it exists and is writable, otherwise ./data in the working directory.

properties.name: opencelium.master-key-file
properties.description: File holding the base64 master key. Must not be combined with the OC_MASTER_KEY environment variable. Default: <data-dir>/master.key.

values.description: Self-hosted: one customer, database configured in application.yml.
Operated for many tenants; application.yml names only the system database.
